about: 회계2 비용관리 흐름(plans/회계2/비용관리.md 6장, 2026-10-20 원본 실측) — 비용내역입력(E060812) 비용코드 · 사원 30,000 회사비용 저장 → 회계전표 없음 → 비용내역조회 [전표번호] 창에서 40,000 · 개인비용으로 수정 → 전표별회계반영(E060814) [가지급금정산서작성] → 차 여비교통비 40,000 / 대 가지급금 40,000 → 비용내역 삭제 → 정산서도 사라짐. 사원 빈칸 저장은 사원 칸 빨간 테두리. 비용 마스터는 API 로 만들고 끝에 지운다.

shots.name: 비용 마스터 준비
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async () => { const a = (await __api('GET', '/accounts')).body.find((x) => x.code === '812'); const r = await __api('POST', '/expense-items', { code: 'QAF-E1', name: 'QA회계2-흐름교통비', accountId: a.id }); sessionStorage.setItem('qaExItem', String(r.body.id)); return r.status === 200 })()

steps: js:document.querySelector('tbody input[aria-label=비용검색]').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); true
js:document.querySelector('tbody input[aria-label=사원검색]').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); true

js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

expect:(async () => { const x = (await __api('GET', '/expenses')).body.find((e) => e.content === 'QA회계2 흐름택시'); if (!x) return false; sessionStorage.setItem('qaExId', String(x.id)); return x.amount === 30000 && x.payType === 'COMPANY' && x.settledJournalId === null && x.expenseItemName === 'QA회계2-흐름교통비' })()

steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true
expect:(async () => { const x = (await __api('GET', '/expenses/' + sessionStorage.getItem('qaExId'))).body; return x.amount === 40000 && x.payType === 'PERSONAL' && x.settledJournalId === null })()

shots.name: 전표별회계반영(비용) — 가지급금정산서 차 여비교통비 / 대 가지급금 40,000
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

expect:(async () => { const x = (await __api('GET', '/expenses/' + sessionStorage.getItem('qaExId'))).body; if (!x.settledJournalId) return false; sessionStorage.setItem('qaExJ', String(x.settledJournalId)); const j = (await __api('GET', '/journals/' + x.settledJournalId)).body; const l = j.lines.map((z) => z.accountCode + ':' + z.debit + ':' + z.credit).join(','); return l === '812:40000:0,134:0:40000' })()

shots.name: 비용내역 삭제 → 정산서도 삭제
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true
expect:(async () => { const r = await __api('DELETE', '/expenses/' + sessionStorage.getItem('qaExId')); sessionStorage.removeItem('qaExId'); return r.status === 204 })()

finally: js:(async () => { const h = {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}; const id = sessionStorage.getItem('qaExId'); if (id) await fetch('/api/expenses/' + id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: h }); const it = sessionStorage.getItem('qaExItem'); if (it) await fetch('/api/expense-items/delete', { method: 'POST', headers: h, body: JSON.stringify([Number(it)]) }); return true })()
